description: This file provides API functions for authentication processes, including registration, login, token refresh, and logout, utilizing an API client and token storage utilities.

methods.name: extractTokens
methods.description: Extracts access and refresh tokens from a backend auth response, supporting multiple response formats.

methods.name: normalizeToken
methods.description: Normalizes a token string by removing 'Bearer' prefix and handling null or undefined strings.

methods.name: safeSetTokens
methods.description: Stores tokens only if they are valid non-empty strings, preventing invalid token storage.

methods.name: registerApplicant
methods.description: Registers a new applicant user by sending email and password to the backend.

methods.name: loginStep1
methods.description: Performs login by validating credentials, clearing old tokens, and storing new tokens if valid.

methods.name: refreshTokens
methods.description: Refreshes authentication tokens by rotating the refresh token.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Logs out the user by revoking the refresh token on the backend.
